crypttab_entries.description: List of encrypted block device entries to configure in crypttab. Each entry defines a mapping for an encrypted volume.

name.description: The name to assign to the mapped device (e.g., 'luks-abc123' or 'home'). Appears under /dev/mapper/<name>.

device.description: Path to the encrypted block device (e.g., /dev/sda2, UUID=..., or /dev/disk/by-uuid/...).

keyfile.description: Path to the key file (e.g., /etc/keys/cryptsetup.key), or '-' to prompt for passphrase interactively.

options.description: Comma-separated list of options (e.g., ['luks', 'tries=3'] or ['plain', 'header=/dev/sdb1']). Common options: luks, plain, header, hash, offset, skip, size, sector-size, tries, timeout.
